reason: Both fully satisfy the phase/percentage/entry-criterion, risk-format, decommission-timing, and halt-metric requirements, but Response B's four-phase design better reflects real migration risk by carving out a distinct final phase for enterprise/complex/disputed accounts rather than lumping them into one large remaining-73% phase, and its halt metrics (e.g., 0.1% discrepancy threshold, per-batch $0 token-authorization validation) are more precise and actionable.
